claim: There is no spectral pair of cardinality 13 in Z/2310Z.

imported_results.name: spectral-to-tiling in Z/210Z
imported_results.use: A projected spectral 13-set would tile, impossible since 13 does not divide 210.

imported_results.name: levelwise cuboid lemma
imported_results.use: A failed Phi_(11d)-to-Phi_d descent makes a cuboid evaluation a nonzero multiple of 11.

imported_results.name: spectral mask-zero characterization
imported_results.use: Differences in either member force zeros of the opposite mask.

proof_map.statement: Phi_11 is absent from both masks; both projections are injective; projected spectrality is forbidden in Z/210Z.
A nonzero cuboid evaluation has absolute value 11, forcing all levels nonempty and exactly the D or T section pattern.
Irreducibility of Phi_11 over Q(zeta_d) forces all section Fourier sums to be equal for every cross-level spectrum difference.
Two double sections give four primitive-cube-root phase cells; each cell meets at most one spectrum level, but ten levels are required.
Four unit complex numbers summing to zero form two antipodal pairs because their root polynomial is even.
A triple section gives three branches; the quotient of two vectors in one branch belongs to no branch, so each branch meets at most one spectrum level, but ten levels are required.

conclusion: Both possible surplus-section patterns are impossible.
